description:
Biju Pucca Ghar Yojana is a significant housing scheme launched by the Government of Odisha in India.

This scheme was initiated in the year 2018.

The primary objective of the Biju Pucca Ghar Yojana is to provide permanent housing to the economically weaker sections of society.

The scheme aims to construct pucca houses for those who currently live in kutcha houses or temporary shelters.

The government has set a target to construct around 2.5 lakh houses under this scheme.

The scheme is particularly focused on providing housing to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and other marginalized communities.

Each beneficiary family is entitled to receive a financial assistance of ₹1.5 lakh.

This amount is provided for the construction of a pucca house.

The financial assistance is disbursed in three installments.

The first installment of ₹50,000 is released after the identification of beneficiaries.

The second installment of ₹50,000 is released after the construction of the house reaches the plinth level.

The final installment of ₹50,000 is provided upon the completion of the house.

The beneficiaries are required to contribute a minimum of 10% of the total cost of the house.

The eligibility criteria for the scheme include being a resident of Odisha.

Beneficiaries must belong to the economically weaker sections.

They should not own a pucca house anywhere in India.

The age limit for applicants is set at 18 years and above.

The scheme is also aimed at women, encouraging them to be the head of the household.

The application process for the Biju Pucca Ghar Yojana is straightforward.

Interested beneficiaries must apply through the Gram Panchayat office.

They need to fill out the application form provided by the Panchayat.

Required documents include proof of identity, proof of residence, and income certificate.

The income ceiling for eligibility is set at ₹1 lakh per annum.

Once the application is submitted, it is verified by the Gram Panchayat.

The verification process includes checking the applicant's eligibility based on the criteria set.

After verification, the list of beneficiaries is published.

The beneficiaries are then informed about their selection.

The disbursement of funds is done through the Direct Benefit Transfer system.

This ensures that the funds reach the beneficiaries directly without any intermediaries.

The timeline for the construction of the houses is generally set at six months from the date of the first installment.

The government aims to complete the construction of all houses within a specified timeframe.

The implementing authority for the Biju Pucca Ghar Yojana is the Housing and Urban Development Department of Odisha.

The department is responsible for the overall implementation and monitoring of the scheme.

Contact details for the Housing and Urban Development Department can be found on the official government website.

The scheme is part of the larger initiative to provide housing for all by 2022.

This initiative aligns with the national goal of providing affordable housing to the urban poor.

The Biju Pucca Ghar Yojana has been instrumental in improving the living conditions of many families.

According to reports, over 1 lakh houses have been constructed under this scheme since its inception.

The scheme has received positive feedback from beneficiaries.

Many have expressed gratitude for the financial assistance provided.

The construction of pucca houses has led to improved safety and security for families.

It has also contributed to better health outcomes due to improved living conditions.

The government has also included provisions for sanitation facilities in the houses constructed.

This includes toilets and proper drainage systems.

The Biju Pucca Ghar Yojana has been a part of the state government's commitment to social welfare.

The scheme has also created employment opportunities in the construction sector.

Local artisans and laborers have benefited from the increased demand for construction work.

The government has emphasized the use of local materials in house construction.

This not only supports local economies but also ensures sustainability.

The scheme has been integrated with the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana for better outreach.

This integration allows for a more comprehensive approach to housing.

The Biju Pucca Ghar Yojana has been recognized as a model for other states to replicate.

The success of the scheme has encouraged the Odisha government to allocate more funds for housing in subsequent budgets.

In the 2021-2022 budget, the government allocated ₹1,000 crore for the Biju Pucca Ghar Yojana.

This allocation reflects the government's commitment to providing housing for all.

The scheme has also been a part of various awareness campaigns.

These campaigns aim to educate the public about the benefits of the scheme.

The government has utilized various media platforms to reach out to potential beneficiaries.

Regular monitoring and evaluation of the scheme are conducted to ensure transparency.

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account for improving the scheme.

The Biju Pucca Ghar Yojana is a crucial step towards achieving the goal of housing for all in Odisha.

It reflects the government's dedication to uplifting the living standards of the underprivileged.

The scheme continues to evolve based on the needs and feedback of the community.

Overall, the Biju Pucca Ghar Yojana stands as a testament to the government's efforts in addressing housing issues in the state of Odisha.
